known_issues: Batemans Bay greeting audio does not match its stored text (edited 2026-09-16, never re-recorded). More generally, audio_files.tts_text is NOT evidence of what callers hear for anything edited before 2026-09-17 - the old edit form wrote only a caption.
Outbound calls carry no recording announcement (two-thirds of answered calls). Inbound is covered by the greetings once they are re-recorded.
Recording does not backfill - 'live' means from the moment the flag went on (2026-09-16). Earlier conversations do not exist and cannot be recovered.

A route decorator silently attaches to whatever function follows it; inserting a helper between @web_bp.route('/admin/audio') and admin_audio hijacked the route. Caught pre-ship; an ast check now asserts no route decorates a private function.

The `permissions` table (tenant DB, migration 066) and LocalPermissionService still exist but grant NOTHING — they are the PermissionService interface implementation and nothing in auth reads them. tenant_users.role in the MASTER db is the only role truth, set only via /admin/users (and defaulted to 'user' at first login in auth/oauth.py:166). The /admin UI that wrote to the dead table was deleted 2026-08-28 and the table is now empty. Do not wire it back up.

Priority 3 (section-based caller ID) is unreachable dead code on watson: phone_numbers.section is blank on all 8 numbers AND LocalStaffDirectory._ext_to_staff() returns no 'section' key (get_sections() returns []). Left in place deliberately — the provider is pluggable and another tenant could supply sections — but it can never fire today. Investigated and deliberately NOT revived 2026-07-30; see that session log before re-attempting.

Twilio 'busy' on an agent Client leg is treated as a human decline (api/routes.py ring-status handler ~line 2456, `rejected = call_status == 'busy'`) — a leg already ringing for another call returns busy, so a second caller entering a thin queue is ejected to voicemail in ~3s. Live on Batemans Bay (1 active member), Wagga (2), Shoalhaven (2); masked on Canberra (6). GitHub issue #2, observed + confirmed in logs 2026-07-20

Queue list shows Answer buttons on non-ringing rows while a ring is pending; clicking one connects you to the ringing caller regardless (post-3f16ef4 the UI now labels this honestly, but it remains confusing). GitHub issue #3
